construction: Both hypothetical latent worlds use the same complete recorded copy-generator output. proof: Every seven-model score, six increment and reference tail is a deterministic function of these observed strings/metadata. This is an identifiability counterexample, not another null mechanism that should test negative.
limitations: Prefix counts are not independent samples; eight prefixes share each of 256 generator runs.
